description: A thread ends while the agent reports waiting: a status-less session.ended clears the agent status, the thread shows the earlier collector waiting (from attention.requested) with source collector, and needs no attention because it has ended.
contract: ADR-0017 (a551aed) decision 6 Precedence ("session.*" clears the agent status; "Otherwise … the latest non-null status among events that are not agent statuses, and the source is collector"), Attention ("its status is waiting, as today, or … blocked with source agent"); Changes "Conformance runner for the M and R groups" ("needsAttention for ended threads is unchanged by this ADR"); ADR-0012 Changes S4a review ("ThreadState.needsAttention (waiting and not ended)"; freshness "ended when the last event is session.ended")

steps.note: session.ended without a status: cleared, ended, no attention
